title: RuntimeBundleManifest
description: A signed runtime bundle complete content-addressed inventory.

artifacts.description: Complete sorted inventory excluding manifest, signature, and SBOM files.

content_sha256.description: SHA-256 over the canonical ordered artifact tuple stream.

cyclonedx.description: CycloneDX JSON document and its signed content hash.

entrypoint.description: Relative executable entrypoint, present in artifacts and executable.

profile.description: Explicit publication profile; unsigned profiles are never implicit.

runtime_components.description:
Optional verified runtime helper payloads. Bundles that provide the
loopback sandbox must declare both entries and their artifact roles.

schema_version.description: Manifest schema version; currently exactly two.

signature_status.description: Truthful detached-signature state for this manifest.

spdx.description: SPDX JSON document and its signed content hash.

BundleArtifact.description: One regular file in the runtime bundle.

license_evidence.description: Non-empty inventoried paths containing license evidence.

license_expression.description: SPDX license expression attributed to this file.

mode.description: Exact Unix permission mode, excluding file-type bits.

path.description: Normalized UTF-8 path relative to the bundle root.

role.description: Semantic role of a runtime helper payload, when applicable.

sha256.description: Lowercase SHA-256 of the file bytes.

BundleArtifactRole.description: Roles reserved for the authenticated loopback runtime helpers.

BundleProfile.description:
Explicit publication profile carried by every runtime-bundle manifest.

Unsigned profiles are intentionally opt-in and are never accepted by the
default verifier or by formal qualification paths.

oneOf.description: Production profile; the manifest must have a trusted detached signature.
Local development profile; integrity metadata remains mandatory.
Explicit tagged-release profile for environments without a release key.

RuntimeComponents.description: Paths of the signed helper payloads consumed by the sandbox launcher.

sidecar.description: Relative path of the sidecar executable.

supervisor.description: Relative path of the supervisor executable.

architecture.description: CPU architecture, such as x86_64 or aarch64.

libc.description: libc family, such as glibc or musl.

libc_version.description: Exact libc ABI version required by the bundle.

SbomDocument.description: Signed identity of one SBOM document.

path.description: Normalized relative path to the JSON document.

sha256.description: Lowercase SHA-256 of its exact bytes.

SignatureStatus.description: Truthful signature state recorded in public bundle metadata.

oneOf.description: The detached manifest signature is present and verified.
No detached manifest signature is present.
